items.reason: The mattifying gel you asked for suits skin that looks shiny by lunchtime and doubles as a light moisturizer.
A gentle, non-stripping cleanser keeps the skin looking fresh without pushing it to rebound with extra shine.
A lightweight mineral SPF 50 protects day to day and sits well under a mattifying gel.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and evening, then apply the mattifying gel, and finish with the SPF in the morning. Keeping it to three steps makes it easy to stick with, and you can reassess after a few weeks.
